data.name: Hammaadi
data.gender_notes: Hammaadi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-m-d, meaning 'to support' or 'to help'. In Islamic context, Hammaadi represents a righteous helper or supporter. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is referred to as Hammaad Allah, meaning 'Helper of Allah'. The name Hammaadi carries the meaning “Supporter, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hammaadi usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of blessings and support from Allah.
data.etymology: Hammaadi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporter, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hammaadi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_urdu.name: حمادی

in_hindi.name: हम्मादी
